title: Cyclotomic anchors, filtered carry collapse, and full-Mersenne claim ceilings

concepts.label: clean binary cyclotomic anchor
concepts.note: A prime divisor p of |Phi_(h q)(2)| with p coprime to hq, exact order hq for 2 modulo p, and p-1 beyond a requested threshold.

concepts.label: cleared finite totient block
concepts.note: The first H totient-tail letters at N cleared by 2^H, whose residue controls denominator-compatible integral tail differences.

concepts.label: prime-filtered carry launch
concepts.note: An integer launch inside the analytic strip and in the single residue class forced by a clean Mersenne prime divisor.

concepts.label: at-most-one three-step locked state
concepts.note: The sole possible filtered launch surviving the first three dyadic carry steps after product-modulus spacing collapses the candidate set.

concepts.label: full Mersenne quotient filter
concepts.note: The composite modulus M=(2^H-1)/v retained after removing the prospective odd denominator factor v, preserving essentially the whole exponential scale.

concepts.label: centered full-Mersenne residue gap
concepts.note: The forced block residue lies in the central open arc outside both endpoint intervals representing the complete analytic launch box.

concepts.label: edge-lock carry rigidity
concepts.note: When a large modulus has no central gap on consecutive basepoints, canonical centered block lifts follow the literal integer carry recurrence without modular wrap.

concepts.label: exact Erdős 249 claim ceiling
concepts.note: A supply predicate proved equivalent to irrationality; the equivalence is a lossless reformulation, not evidence that either side holds.

concepts.label: period-30 fixed certificate
concepts.note: Two kernel-checked finite kills and one deeper exact residue datum at the composite cyclotomic anchor h=30.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED UNCONDITIONAL SUPPORT: if q and p are prime and p divides 2^q-1, then the order of 2 modulo p is q and q divides p-1. The exact X-2 layer therefore satisfies the degree-one order consumer and clean layer-supply hypotheses, yielding prime divisors beyond every size bound at arbitrarily remote prime indices.
statement_nodes.engine: multiplicative order in ZMod p, primality of q, Fermat-Lagrange divisibility, and the abstract bounded-degree order-consumer theorem
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The prime-index Mersenne divisor congruence p≡1 mod q is classical. The repository packages it into its prime-ray supply interface; no priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Unbounded prime support supplies clean arithmetic anchors only. It proves no tail discrepancy, carry kill, cofinal certificate supply, or irrationality of the binary totient series.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EXACT BLOCK DYNAMICS: (2^H-1)R_N is the integer block Q_(H,N) plus R_(N+H)-R_N; sliding N advances Q by the same affine recurrence as the carry modulo the exact multiple (2^H-1)phi(N+1). Consequently a carry initially congruent to -Q modulo any divisor p of 2^H-1 remains congruent to the shifted negative block at every depth.
statement_nodes.engine: finite tail splitting, the totient-tail recurrence, and induction of the affine congruence
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Exact finite-block and affine recurrence algebra for the repository's tail coordinate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The residue orbit is a consumer interface. It neither makes the true tail difference integral nor supplies a modulus or an escaping carry.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PRODUCT-MODULUS SPACING: two launches in one class modulo M differ at carry depth K by a multiple of 2^K M, so a strip of radius below 2^(K-1)M contains at most one survivor. At a clean prime basepoint N
statement_nodes.engine: exact carry-orbit difference, nonzero modular spacing, and comparison with the combined endpoint-strip width
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary spacing in an affine dyadic recurrence.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Uniqueness says at most one candidate survives. It does not show that the remaining candidate escapes.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FOUR-STATE CLASSIFICATION: at a clean anchor with H<=p-1, every denominator-compatible launch in the analytic initial interval is one of r-2p, r-p, r, or r+p for the canonical residue r. All four representatives lie in the forced class, and after three carry steps their locked subset has cardinality at most one.
statement_nodes.engine: Euclidean residue normal form plus the depth-three product-modulus spacing theorem
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Finite modular classification in the exact analytic launch interval.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The reduction replaces O(p) launches by four and then at most one; it does not kill the surviving state or provide cofinally many usable anchors.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE CERTIFICATE EQUIVALENCE: a four-state kill is exactly emptiness of the locked-through set and is monotone in depth. From depth three onward it is equivalent to killing only the at-most-one locked state, and under clean prime geometry it is exactly the original residue-filtered carry-kill predicate.
statement_nodes.engine: finite-set emptiness, depth monotonicity, four-state classification, and three-step uniqueness
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lossless executable normal forms for the same finite certificate predicate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Equivalence of finite search encodings does not establish any certificate, let alone a cofinal supply.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED POINTWISE SEARCH CHARACTERISATION: assuming the denominator filter for an integral tail difference, a finite prime-filtered kill proves that difference nonintegral. Conversely, nonintegrality of the fixed tail difference implies that some uniform finite depth kills every candidate in the finite filtered interval.
statement_nodes.engine: analytic tail-strip bounds, exact carry tracking, and finite maximisation of pointwise escape depths
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A soundness/completeness theorem for the local finite certificate interface.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Completeness is pointwise after nonintegrality is assumed. It does not prove nonintegrality at any new height or a cofinal supply.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED BASEPOINT-DECOUPLED NORMAL FORM: at an arbitrary basepoint the filtered launch set has at most one three-step survivor under clean prime geometry, and also under a composite modulus wider than the analytic radius. Filtered and single-locked certificates are depth-monotone and equivalent from depth three onward; setting N=p-1 recovers the original prime-predecessor predicate.
statement_nodes.engine: free-basepoint product-modulus spacing and exact translation between launch indices and integer states
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A lossless generalisation of the finite prime-predecessor search interface.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Basepoint freedom permits a later arithmetic construction but supplies neither the modulus nor terminal escape.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FREE-BASEPOINT SEARCH CHARACTERISATION: a filtered kill plus the correct block congruence excludes integrality of the true H-step tail difference at any N; conversely, nonintegrality of that fixed difference yields some finite filtered-kill depth.
statement_nodes.engine: the exact carry/tail identity and finite uniformisation over the analytic launch interval
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Pointwise soundness and completeness of the basepoint-decoupled certificate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is local in H,N,p. It does not prove any global supply or the required congruence from rationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED DENOMINATOR FILTER: if vR_N and the H-step tail difference are integers, then a prime p coprime to v dividing 2^H-1 forces the difference into -Q_(H,N) modulo p. More strongly, an exact factorisation vM=2^H-1 forces the same class modulo the full quotient M without a primality hypothesis.
statement_nodes.engine: the exact cleared-block identity followed by cancellation of v in integers or prime coprimality
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Exact denominator-clearing algebra in the paper's tail coordinates.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The filter is conditional on integrality of the scaled tail and the tail difference. It does not assert rationality or produce a contradiction without a kill or gap.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FULL-QUOTIENT GEOMETRY: a launch in the full-Mersenne residue class forces vR_N within 2(N+H+2)/M of an integer. Every noninteger real has a positive lattice gap, so once this error is smaller no launch exists. Irrationality makes all positive integer scalings of shifted tails nonintegral, while a rational value with denominator 2^c v makes vR_N integral for every N>=c.
statement_nodes.engine: exact block identity, distance to the integer lattice, exponential quotient size, and dyadic/odd denominator splitting
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary Diophantine approximation and denominator-clearing lemmas specialised to the actual totient tail.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The forward near-integer implication alone proves nothing. The global conclusions below remain equivalent reformulations of the unknown irrationality statement.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED UNCONDITIONAL CLEAN ANCHORS: |Phi_n(2)| divides 2^n-1, and a prime divisor p of a positive binary cyclotomic layer has n=p^a ord_p(2). For every h>0 and threshold N0 one can choose a prime q and clean prime divisor p of |Phi_(hq)(2)| with p coprime to hq, exact order hq, hq dividing p-1, and p-1>=N0; hence the concrete binary layers satisfy CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply.
statement_nodes.engine: cyclotomic divisibility, finite-field order decomposition, prime selection beyond max(h,N0,2^h), and elimination of the characteristic-prime case
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Built from standard cyclotomic and Dirichlet ingredients; the exact clean-anchor packaging has not been priority-assessed.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This completely supplies anchor provenance but not the cofinal terminal carry kill attached to those anchors.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PERIOD TRANSPORT: if R_(N+h)-R_N is integral at every sufficiently late N, then R_(N+hk)-R_N is integral for every k and every such N by telescoping k adjacent h-step differences.
statement_nodes.engine: finite telescoping of adjacent tail differences
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard period-multiple telescoping.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The lemma propagates a supplied eventual integrality law; it neither proves such a law nor proves its negation.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT CLAIM-CEILING FAMILY: the cofinal residue-filtered, literal four-state, and one-locked-state cyclotomic supplies are mutually lossless; they feed the free-basepoint supply and each closes irrationality. Under clean Mersenne-dividing anchors irrationality reconstructs the filtered certificates, so for the concrete binary layers—and for the basepoint-decoupled supply—these predicates are each equivalent to Erdős #249.
open_antecedents: the truth of any equivalent cofinal terminal-kill supply remains exactly the unresolved irrationality of the binary totient series
statement_nodes.engine: finite predicate equivalences, clean-anchor supply, rational-denominator splitting, pointwise certificate soundness and completeness
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: These theorems establish equivalence architecture, not the truth of the open predicate. The reasoning-surface paper explicitly reports them as reductions rather than narrowing progress.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: No cofinal kill supply is proved independently. Equivalence to Irrational S must not be read as a solution of #249.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT FULL-QUOTIENT CLAIM CEILING: for every prospective dyadic preperiod c and positive odd denominator part v, the supply of a remote Euler-multiple H whose quotient M=(2^H-1)/v is wider than the initial radius and whose sole three-step survivor eventually escapes is equivalent to irrationality of the binary totient series.
open_antecedents: FullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply is not proved independently of assuming irrationality
statement_nodes.engine: Euler divisibility, exponential-over-linear quotient growth, pointwise certificate completeness, denominator clearing, and lossless one-state/full-filter conversion
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: An exact reformulation of #249, not a new proof of either side.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The reverse theorem starts from irrationality. The equivalence therefore identifies the residual but contributes no unconditional cofinal escape.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CENTERED-RESIDUE DYNAMICS: modulo any M dividing 2^H-1, the block residue doubles and subtracts the next delta-totient letter when N advances. The canonical signed lift represents the same class; if the two signed sides fit inside one modulus, the modular recurrence is literal equality. With sufficient room, central-arc escape is exactly the centered lift exceeding the analytic radius.
statement_nodes.engine: the exact block recurrence, Euclidean remainders, canonical centering, and a quantitative no-wrap lemma
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Exact modular dynamics and centered-representative arithmetic.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The recurrence describes the residue orbit. It does not prove central escape at any cofinal family of heights.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE ESCAPE TRANSPORT: if a sufficiently large Mersenne divisor has no central gap at two adjacent basepoints, centered lifts obey the literal affine recurrence; over an edge-locked interval they equal the ordinary carry orbit. Therefore one carry escape, a survivorKill, or a certifiedKill forces a genuine centered full-Mersenne gap at or before the checked depth.
statement_nodes.engine: quantitative no-wrap at adjacent edges, induction over an interval, and contrapositive transport of finite carry escape
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A project-specific exact bridge from existing finite certificates to the full-Mersenne residue geometry; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Each theorem is finite and requires explicit large-modulus room. It does not supply cofinally many compatible H,N,M or solve #249.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ZERO-LAUNCH NORMAL FORM: for positive modulus M, absence of every representative of the forced block class in the initial interval [-B,B] is equivalent to the least nonnegative residue lying in the central open arc. Every positive-height factorisation vM=2^H-1 has M>0, so the equivalence applies to the intended full quotient.
statement_nodes.engine: Euclidean residue classification of all representatives in a symmetric interval
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary modular normal form.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This identifies two finite predicates. It does not prove that either gap occurs.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT ARITHMETIC CLAIM CEILING: irrationality supplies a full-Mersenne initial gap at every prescribed basepoint and hence cofinally; conversely such gaps exclude every rational denominator. Initial-gap and centered-residue supplies are equivalent to #249, and the basepoint may be fixed canonically at the dyadic denominator exponent c without loss.
open_antecedents: the cofinal centered residue gap is itself exactly the unresolved irrationality statement, not an independently supplied theorem
statement_nodes.engine: uniform integer-lattice gap of vR_N, Euler-multiple quotient growth, denominator clearing, and exact initial/centered/canonical-basepoint transports
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The paper describes the centered remainder as an arithmetic normal form of #249. These equivalences localise the open content without proving it.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: No theorem here proves the centered residue gap without assuming irrationality or an equivalent supply. This is a reformulation of #249, not its resolution.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT FINITE-STATE CLAIM CEILING: cyclotomic four-state supply implies irrationality; with clean Mersenne-dividing anchors it is equivalent to irrationality. For the concrete binary cyclotomic layers both the literal four-state supply and the one-locked-state supply are exactly Erdős #249.
open_antecedents: no cofinal four-state or single-locked-state kill supply is proved independently for the binary cyclotomic layers

statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The at-most-one state reduction is unconditional locally; its eventual escape at cofinally many anchors is exactly the unresolved content.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT ANCHORED CLAIM CEILING: the guard-cylinder normal form and the arbitrary-depth cyclotomic anchored-kill supply are equivalent. Either supply implies irrationality; clean anchors plus irrationality repopulate it, and for the concrete binary cyclotomic layers both formulations are exactly Erdős #249.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE CERTIFICATES: at H=30 the kernel checks certified kills at the natural basepoint N=300 with depth 13 and the prime anchor N=330 with depth 10; the deeper natural window has exact depth-16 residue 2928 modulo 2^16. The natural certificate proves that the binary totient series equals no rational whose denominator divides 2^300(2^30-1).
statement_nodes.engine: kernel-decided exact finite totient arithmetic and the sound certified-kill denominator-exclusion consumer
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-specific finite certificates. They make no priority claim and do not establish an asymptotic pattern.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The composite-index binary cyclotomic theorem replaces the prime-index Mersenne layer by |Phi_(hq)(2)| and additionally eliminates the characteristic-prime case to obtain exact clean order hq.
The four-state classification applies the general modular spacing theorem at clean prime modulus p and depth three.
The lossless one-state reduction is possible because the explicit four-state set has at most one member locked through depth three.
Finite predicate equivalence compresses the search, while soundness/completeness identifies what success or failure means for one fixed true tail difference.
The basepoint-decoupled construction uses the same modulus-spacing mechanism with N independent of the filtering modulus.
The same pointwise search semantics hold at arbitrary N; N=p-1 recovers the prime-predecessor version.
The denominator filter is obtained by combining integrality with the exact identity (2^H-1)R_N=Q plus the H-step tail difference.
The filter supplies the congruence hypothesis needed by the sound free-basepoint kill consumer.
Retaining the exact quotient M turns one compatible residue-class launch into a quantitative near-integer approximation to vR_N.
Clean anchors are unconditional, but the terminal filtered-kill field attached to cofinally many of them is precisely the unresolved side of the equivalence.
Pointwise soundness and completeness lift to the cofinal supply equivalence once clean anchors and denominator clearing are composed.
The full-quotient supply uses the scaled-tail lattice gap and exponential quotient growth to collapse the entire initial launch set.
Its finite residual is exactly the composite-modulus free-basepoint predicate after the quotient is made wider than the analytic radius.
Two-edge and interval rigidity iterate the centered modular recurrence after large-modulus room removes every wrap.
The initial no-launch predicate is the Euclidean representative form of the same central-arc gap encoded by the centered lift.
The supply equivalences lift the exact finite initial/centered normal form through every prospective denominator.
The zero-launch centered gap removes even the one locked state, yielding a sharper but still equivalent arithmetic claim ceiling.
The literal four-state and one-state supplies are lossless finite normal forms of the same filtered cofinal predicate.
The terminal guard-cylinder socket is another exact finite normal form of the certified anchored kill at the same clean cyclotomic provenance.
The irrationality consumer defeats a hypothetical eventual period h using a certified discrepancy at an anchored multiple hq.
The two period-30 certified kills are fixed finite inputs accepted by the general certificate-to-full-Mersenne-gap transport.
Two fixed certified anchors and one denominator exclusion do not satisfy the cofinal clean-anchor quantifier in the claim-ceiling supply.
